scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @roomly/api" "npm run dev --workspace @roomly/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @roomly/web && npm run build --workspace @roomly/api
scripts.test:unit: npm run test --workspace @roomly/api -- test/email.unit.spec.ts && npm run test --workspace @roomly/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run test --workspace @roomly/api -- test/app.e2e.spec.ts test/auth.e2e.spec.ts test/bookings.e2e.spec.ts test/rooms.e2e.spec.ts test/admin.e2e.spec.ts test/database.integration.spec.ts test/seed.integration.spec.ts
scripts.test:smoke: npm run db:reset && npm run test:browser --workspace @roomly/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
